name: Station List

business_logic: 1. Load cached station list from local storage, termasuk kolom icon

2. Query local draft records (weighbridge-record/grading-record/cages-track-record/threshing-record/pressing-record/depricarping-record/kernel-plant-record) WHERE created_by = current user AND status IN (draft_ongoing, draft_paused) -> hasDraft boolean per active station type. 2026-08-23: threshing/pressing/depricarping/kernel-plant memakai getDrafts(userId) direduksi ke boolean via length > 0, bukan getSummary()/getProgressSummary() milik 3 stasiun lama.
3. Render grid: is_active=true -> tappable, icon default per type termasuk threshing/pressing/depricarping/kernel-plant; is_active=false -> disabled/info only
6. On tap active station -> navigate ke Monitor screen (monitor-weighbridge/monitor-grading/monitor-cages-track/monitor-threshing/monitor-pressing/monitor-depricarping/monitor-kernel-plant)
7. On tap disabled station -> show info, no navigation
9. On tap hamburger -> open nav menu
